verses.text: This is the day that Yahweh has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!
Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don't lean on your own understanding.
I can do all things through Christ, who strengthens me.
Be still, and know that I am God.
I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.
Rejoicing in hope; enduring in troubles; continuing steadfastly in prayer.
Casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.
Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.
Don't you be afraid, for I am with you. Don't be dismayed, for I am your God.
Even so, let your light shine before men, that they may see your good works and glorify your Father who is in heaven.
Let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.
Oh taste and see that Yahweh is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.
Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.
Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.
Yahweh is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing.
Yahweh bless you, and keep you.
